title: Foundations
description: These hold everywhere in the app. A change that breaks one of them is a bug, whatever feature it belongs to.

stories.want: every screen to behave the same way
stories.soThat: I never have to learn a screen twice

requirements.text: The GitHub token never reaches the web view: no command returns it and no log line contains it.

Requests that carry the token only go to `https://api.github.com`. Signing in talks to `github.com`, without a token. A job's log is fetched from where the API redirects, and only from GitHub's log hosts.

history.text: The Rust side only talks to `https://api.github.com`.
history.reason: The first wording was taken from the README and was wrong: signing in with the device flow has to call `github.com`, and GitHub serves job logs from other hosts. What matters is where the token goes.

requirements.text: Nothing from outside (GitHub responses, command results, stored values) is used before a zod schema has checked it.
Opening a screen from a list shows no spinner when the link was on screen first: its data is loaded ahead.
The Android back button closes an open sheet before it leaves the screen.
Without an account, the app still shows public profiles, repositories, releases and code.
The code and the tests cite the requirements they meet or prove, as a comment `Spec:` followed by the ids. A test fails when a cited id isn't a requirement in the spec, or is deprecated.
